# `make_timestamp`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Create the current timestamp with local time zone from year, month, day, hour, min, sec and timezone fields. If the configuration `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` is false, the function returns NULL on invalid inputs. Otherwise, it will throw an error instead.

make_timestamp(date[, time[, timezone]]) - Create timestamp from date and time fields.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
make_timestamp(year, month, day, hour, min, sec[, timezone])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2, 3, 6, 7] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_timestamp, example 1
> SELECT make_timestamp(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887);
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp, example 2
> SELECT make_timestamp(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887, 'CET');
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp, example 3
> SELECT make_timestamp(DATE'2014-12-28');
2014-12-28 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp, example 4
> SELECT make_timestamp(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887');
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp, example 5
> SELECT make_timestamp(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887', 'CET');
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```
